  • Develop account strategies for complex enterprise opportunities and drive deals through multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • Build relationships across the APAC AI and enterprise technology ecosystem

What We're Looking For

  • Approximately 5–12 years of B2B technology sales experience, although we care more about your track record than years of experience

  • A proven quota-carrying enterprise sales track record

  • Demonstrated experience personally sourcing, progressing, negotiating, and closing new enterprise customers

  • Strong new-business hunting skills and the ability to generate your own pipeline

  • Experience selling technically complex products or infrastructure

  • Comfortable selling to both technical stakeholders and senior business decision-makers

  • Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills

  • Comfortable operating without a mature sales playbook, large support organization, or established brand

  • Able to move quickly, operate independently, and adapt as priorities and products evolve

  • Based in Singapore, Hong Kong, or other SEA countries, with strong knowledge of APAC enterprise markets

  • Fluent English communication skills

Particularly Relevant Backgrounds

Experience selling any of the following is highly relevant:

  • AI infrastructure or GPU cloud

  • Cloud compute or infrastructure

  • Data infrastructure

  • Enterprise storage

  • Databases or data platforms

  • HPC or accelerated computing

  • Developer infrastructure

  • Infrastructure SaaS / PaaS

  • Data center or cloud connectivity solutions

Experience at an early-stage or high-growth technology company is a strong plus.


What we offer

title: Working Student (f/m/d) - IT Infrastructure
description: At Instagrid, you are part of the clean-tech revolution by bringing pure energy into your region, helping professional workers transitioning away from combustion generators and making it possible for them to experience a safe, efficient, clean and silent energy solution. Your mission As a working student in our IT team, you support the day-to-day operation of our IT infrastructure and actively contribute to projects. You are the first point of contact for our colleagues when it comes to technical questions, and you make sure that workplaces and devices run reliably. Along the way, you'll get to know a modern, fully cloud-based Microsoft 365 environment from the ground up. Your Impact 1st Level Support / Helpdesk: You are the first contact for IT requests and incidents – you log tickets, resolve issues independently or escalate them in a well-prepared way, and document your solutions. On-Site Service: You provide hands-on deskside support directly at our Ludwigsburg site – setting up and handing over hardware, troubleshooting at the workplace, and assisting colleagues in person with their devices and peripherals. IT Onboarding: You prepare workplaces and end-user devices (Windows & Mac) for new colleagues, set up user accounts in Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, and support them through their first IT day. Client Management & Maintenance: You manage and maintain our endpoints via Intune, take care of software deployment, updates, and configurations, and keep an eye on the device inventory. Project Work: You support IT infrastructure and automation projects, e.g. rollouts, the introduction of new tools, or the improvement of existing processes. Documentation: You maintain guides and our internal knowledge base so that knowledge stays accessible to everyone. You are an enrolled student, ideally in (business) informatics or a comparable field of study – though all tech-enthusiastic study programs are welcome. You have an interest in or initial experience with Microsoft 365 (e.g. Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Entra ID, Intune). You bring basic knowledge of operating and administering Windows and macOS devices. You work in a service- and solution-oriented way, enjoy communicating with people, and take a structured approach. You are confident in both German and English (spoken and written). You work independently and reliably, and you are curious to learn new things. Your benefits Flexible working hours Generous vacation entitlement plus additional special leave days (pro rata basis) The opportunity to work in a company at the forefront of innovation This is Instagrid Pure instant power. Anywhere. We have created the world’s most advanced portable power supplies, bringing freedom to the way our customers work. With you we want to shape a world where advanced technology meets environmental responsibility and create lasting impact. Driven by our curiosity and the desire to leave tomorrow's world cleaner than we found it yesterday. Join us in transitioning away from combustion generators to a cleaner alternative for fast, measurable, and real outcomes. What we’ve achieved so far is just the beginning. At Instagrid, we are deeply committed to equal employment opportunities as we believe in the power of diverse teams. We do not just accept diversity but actively search for the best talent regardless of gender, ethnical origin, age, religion, sexual orientation or place of origin. Working as a team, we treat each other with respect and value each other’s opinions to achieve our common goals. We are looking forward to receiving your application! title: Account Executive – Strategic Retail, DACH and Central Europe (German Speaking)
description: Bazaarvoice is looking for an extraordinarily talented, high-performing Account Executive to join our EMEA sales team. This role is designed for a unique, new-business hunter who craves a challenge, thrives outside their comfort zone, and possesses the strategic rigor to manage a high-value retail territory across DACH and Central Europe.  As an Account Executive for Strategic Retail, you will build a pipeline and drive the sales cycle from start to finish. If you are a consultative storyteller who can navigate complex enterprise organizations, build consensus, and defend a high-ROI solution to C-level executives, we want to hear from you. Key Responsibilities: Orchestrate the Territory Ecosystem: Act as the strategic leader of your territory. Conduct account planning, territory management, and continuous pipeline generation, while rallying internal cross-functional resources to maximize coverage and close deals. End-to-End Deal Architecture: Manage the entire lifecycle of high-value enterprise SaaS deals—from initial prospecting and precise qualification to sophisticated contract negotiation and closure. Strategic Opportunity Mapping: Move beyond standard discovery to conduct deep-dive analyses into a retailer's business model. Reveal latent pain points and align Bazaarvoice’s high-ROI solutions with their business objectives. Value Defense & Executive Presence: Partner with a prospect’s marketing, merchandising, and technology staff. Confidently demonstrate and defend the ROI of our platform, successfully building consensus from Marketing Managers up to CMO, CTO, and Procurement levels. High-Velocity Discipline & Forecasting: Drive urgency throughout the sales funnel, handle objections with resilience, and maintain a high volume of outbound activity. Deliver exceptional qualification and accurate forecasting over a two-quarter period. Thought Leadership: Stay ahead of e-commerce industry trends, competitor movements, and shifts in consumer behavior to provide proactive strategic guidance. What You'll Bring: Proven Track Record: 3 year experience in a customer-facing, new-business SaaS hunter role, with a proven history of managing high-value portfolios and consistently exceeding quotas. Retail & Digital Savvy: Strong knowledge of and experience selling into large, complex retail organizations. Strategic & Financial Acumen: Expert in value-selling innovative software in a fast-changing space. Ability to articulate complex ROI models and use data-driven storytelling to win complex "consensus" buys. Collaborative Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead internal support teams, articulate a clear account strategy, and secure the internal resources needed to win. The Bazaarvoice DNA: A high level of enthusiasm, coachability, and an unwavering work ethic. You are comfortable hearing "no," shaking it off, and pivoting your strategy to find the "yes." Language: German language proficiency at Native or C1 minimum . Right to Work: Eligibility to work in France without restrictions. Desirable Criteria: Industry Background: 3+ years of experience selling e-commerce, MarTech, or digital marketing technology, with established relationships up to the CMO level. Brand Experience: Experience selling to large consumer brands in addition to major retailers. Global Mindset: Additional European language skills are a strong plus. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Net New Revenue: Driving net new business within the Retail segment. Pipeline Velocity & Accuracy: Consistently generating pipeline and moving opportunities through the funnel with speed and precise forecasting. Cross-Functional Leadership: Successfully leveraging and orchestrating your internal support resources to maximize territory efficiency and deal sizes. description: TechQuartier Seit zehn Jahren ist das TechQuartier der Ort in Frankfurt, an dem durch Events, Programme und Accelerator-Initiativen die richtigen Menschen zusammenkommen. Als zentraler Innovationstreiber am Finanzplatz Frankfurt vernetzt das TechQuartier Gründer:innen von FinTech- und GreenTech-Start-ups mit etablierten Unternehmen aus zukunftsweisenden Bereichen wie KI, Quantencomputing, Finanzwesen, GreenTech und Mittelstand. Seit 2017 ist das TechQuartier Teil der Digital Hub Initiative (de:hub) des Bundes und wurde 2024 offiziell als FinTech Hub Frankfurt anerkannt. TechQuartier ist zudem Veranstalter und Gastgeber des IMPACT FESTIVAL in Frankfurt – Deutschlands größte B2B-Veranstaltung für digitale & nachhaltige Transformation. Das TechQuartier treibt das Start-up-Ökosystem in der Region Frankfurt Rhein-Main kontinuierlich voran und stärkt seine Rolle als zentraler Innovationsknotenpunkt in Europa. Wenn Du Lust hast, in einem dynamischen Umfeld Verantwortung zu übernehmen, eigene Ideen einzubringen und gemeinsam mit uns Innovation voranzutreiben, bist Du bei uns genau richtig. Werde ab November in Vollzeit Teil unseres Teams. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Warum diese Rolle echten Impact hat Unser Coworking-Space ist ein lebendiger Ort, an dem Menschen kreativ arbeiten, sich vernetzen und durch vielfältige Events zusammenkommen. Um dieses Umfeld zu ermöglichen, braucht es eine starke organisatorische Basis. Als ( Senior) Event & Operations Manager:in übernimmst Du genau diese Verantwortung. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Space im Alltag reibungslos läuft und unsere Veranstaltungen im Coworking-Space von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung professionell organisiert sind. Dein Beitrag macht den Unterschied zwischen einem Ort, der einfach funktioniert, und einem Ort, der Membern, Gäst:innen und Eventeilnehmenden positiv in Erinnerung bleibt. Was Du bei uns bewegst Du planst, betreust und bereitest externe und interne Veranstaltungen in unserem Coworking-Space vor und nach. Du machst Erfolg messbar: Gemeinsam mit den Teams definierst du Erfolgskennzahlen, leitest daraus Prioritäten ab und misst den Erfolg neuer Produktinitiativen. Dein Profil Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement – idealerweise mit digitalen Produkten, die eine hohe Komplexität und Reichweite haben, und bringst Erfahrung in der Weiterentwicklung digitaler Produkte mit. Du hast Strategie in Features übersetzt – nicht nur verwaltet, sondern aktiv gestaltet. Du kannst zeigen, welche Produkte du konzeptionell vorangebracht und von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung begleitet hast. Du verstehst, was mobile Produkte anders macht als Web – du musst kein App-Store-Experte sein, aber du kennst die Unterschiede in UX, Architektur und Nutzerverhalten. Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Produktstrategie, Priorisierung und Stakeholder-Kommunikation mit und kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen in klare Produktentscheidungen übersetzen. Du bringst eine ausgeprägte KI-Affinität mit und nutzt KI-Tools souverän, um Produktideen zu schärfen, Anforderungen zu strukturieren, Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und datenbasierte Entscheidungen vorzubereiten. Du schreibst Anforderungen mit Substanz – klar, vollständig, priorisiert. Deine User Stories sind keine Platzhalter, sondern Arbeitsgrundlage. Du arbeitest strukturiert und kreativ zugleich: Du hast Methoden für Ideenfindung und Konzeption – und die Disziplin, Ergebnisse festzuhalten. Du kannst fachlich coachen , ohne disziplinarisch zu führen. Du gibst Feedback, das Kolleg:innen weiterbringt. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1-Niveau). Außerdem kannst du sicher auf Englisch kommunizieren. Du lässt dich vom fußballbegeisterten Spirit deiner Teammitglieder anstecken und bringst idealerweise selbst deine Leidenschaft für Fußball mit ein. Da sich unser Büro in Hamburg befindet, ist die Stelle vorzugsweise an unserem Standort in Hamburg zu besetzen. Gleichzeitig bieten wir die Möglichkeit, flexibel im hybriden Modell zu arbeiten. Deine Vorteile bei uns Begeisterung für Fußball: Unser internationales Team teilt eine leidenschaftliche Liebe zum Fußball – du hast die Möglichkeit, dieses hautnah im Stadion zu erleben, indem du von VIP- und Dauerkarten profitierst. Spielraum für Innovation: Entfalte neue Ideen und nutze Formate wie Brownbags und Reviews, um kontinuierlich unsere Weiterentwicklung voranzutreiben. Flexibilität: Profitiere von mobiler Arbeit, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Workation-Möglichkeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. Teamzusammenhalt: Regelmäßige "Get-Together" und Team-Events stärken unseren Teamgeist. Von unterhaltsamen Fußballquizzen bis hin zu anderen sportlichen Aktivitäten und unseren festlichen Weihnachtsfeiern. Entwicklungschancen: Wir unterstützen deine Weiterbildung durch Seminare, Weiterbildungen und die Teilnahme an Konferenzen zur Vernetzung. Unsere wöchentlichen internen Englischkurse tragen nicht nur zur Verbesserung deiner Sprachkenntnisse bei, sondern stärken auch die Vernetzung innerhalb Transfermarkt. Mobilität: Nutze die Möglichkeit, das Deutschlandticket vergünstigt zu erwerben, um flexibel und kostengünstig zu reisen. Zukunftssicherung: Wir fördern deine finanzielle Absicherung mit Zuschüssen zur VWL und betrieblichen Altersvorsorge. Wohlfühlatmosphäre im Büro: Wir stellen Getränke, Obst und Snacks für dich bereit. title: Product Manager: Customer Onboarding Experience
description: About You You are a technically fluent, customer-obsessed PM who gets energized by removing friction from developer workflows. You have a strong instinct for what makes integrations feel fast and safe, and you know how to balance developer needs with long-term product maintainability. You bring systems thinking to SDK and tracking decisions, hold a high bar for integration correctness and reliability, and are energized by the challenge of reducing time-to-value for the teams and customers who depend on you. About Us Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so. Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco. We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things. Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today. About the Position As the PM for Customer Developer Experience + Customer Data Integrations, you will own the end-to-end integration journey for Constructor's customers and SIs — from first setup through long-term adoption. Your north star is time-to-value: making it fast, correct, and reliable for any team to integrate with Constructor and start getting results. You will span two tightly connected surfaces: CDX — SDKs, UI libraries, integration patterns, docs, and the extensibility model that lets customers build on Constructor without accumulating hidden complexity. CDI — tracking/instrumentation, data attributes, event validation tooling, and the reliability + correctness of the data flows that power Constructor's AI. Day-to-day, you will: Define and drive a roadmap that measurably reduces integration time, defects, and escalations. Improve integration correctness for key tracking flows (search → PDP → conversion, sponsored click tracking, etc.) by reducing common failure modes and adding robust validation and diagnostics. Build and evolve validation and debugging tooling that empowers customers, Solutions Engineers, and Customer Success to self-serve faster. Define clear support and capability boundaries to reduce high-visibility escalations and improve customer predictability. Partner with Engineering, Solutions/CS, and other Product teams to sequence work, de-risk launches, and ensure new capabilities ship integration-ready. Define and report a CDX+CDI KPI stack (time-to-first-value, adoption, defect rate, escalation volume, doc findability) and drive continuous improvement. Requirements 3+ years of product management experience shipping developer-facing or integration-heavy products — such as SDKs, APIs, web tracking/instrumentation, data pipelines, or developer tooling. Demonstrated ability to reduce time-to-value or integration complexity in a B2B SaaS environment — with concrete, measurable outcomes. Technical fluency sufficient to reason credibly about event flows, browser/web constraints, attribution, versioning, breaking changes, and rollout risk — without needing to be an engineer. Track record of strong cross-functional collaboration: aligning Engineering, Customer Success, Solutions, and other Product teams on priorities and support boundaries. Comfort defining metrics and making decisions with imperfect data; experience building and reporting product health dashboards. Strong written communication — clear specs, integration guides, capability docs, and stakeholder updates. apoprojekt ist Partner für jeden Transformationsbedarf im Bestand und eines der dynamischsten Unternehmen der Bau- und Immobilienbranche. Seit unserer Gründung 2007 sind wir von einem Zwei-Mann-Unternehmen zu einer Größe von mehr als 600 Mitarbeitenden gewachsen. Wir wollen den Markt verändern: Mit unserem Design & Build-Ansatz und weniger Schnittstellen zwischen Planung und Ausführung. Mit mehr Miteinander und voller Verantwortung für unsere Projekte. Um die besten Teams der Branche zusammenzustellen, suchen wir die kompetentesten und talentiertesten Mitarbeitenden. Und dafür brauchen wir genau Dich! Was uns besonders auszeichnet, ist unsere gelebte Werte- und Unternehmenskultur. Bei uns erwarten Dich nicht nur Aufgaben mit einer steilen Lernkurve – sondern auch ein spürbarer Teamspirit. Bist Du dabei?


DEINE HERAUSFORDERUNG

  • Du entwickelst komplexe Unternehmenslösungen im Microsoft-Cloud-Umfeld und übernimmst Verantwortung für Backend, Frontend, Middleware, Schnittstellen und Integrationen.
  • Du steuerst KI-Agenten wie GitHub Copilot, Claude Code oder vergleichbare Werkzeuge gezielt im Entwicklungsprozess und validierst, korrigierst und integrierst deren Ergebnisse.
  • Du führst technische Reviews für KI-generierten Code durch und unterstützt Junior Engineers bei der Anwendung von AI-Augmented Engineering Methoden.
  • Du überführst Prototypen und Fachbereichsanforderungen in stabile, sichere, wartbare und skalierbare Softwarelösungen gemäß Architekturvorgaben.
  • Du setzt DevOps- und CI/CD-Prozesse ein, erstellst Tests und Dokumentationen und begleitest Lösungen bis in den produktionsnahen Betrieb.
  • Du entwickelst Lösungen, in denen KI-Funktionen selbst Bestandteil der Anwendung sind, z. B. agentenbasierte Workflows, eingebettete KI-Tasks oder intelligente Automatisierungen.


DEIN PROFIL, UM GEMEINSAM ETWAS ZU BEWEGEN

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in professioneller Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise im Microsoft-Cloud-Umfeld.
  • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in C#, .NET, Azure, APIs, Datenbanken, Webtechnologien sowie Backend-, Frontend- und Integrationsarchitekturen mit.
  • Du kennst moderne DevOps-Praktiken, CI/CD,Testing, Versionierung, Dokumentation, Security-Grundlagen und Betriebsanforderungen produktiver Softwarelösungen.
  • Du kannst KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge nicht nur bedienen, sondern deren Ergebnisse technisch bewerten, verbessern und verantwortungsvoll in produktive Lösungen integrieren.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, qualitätsbewusst und lösungsorientiert und kannst technische Konzepte verständlich mit Architektur, Betrieb, Projektteams und Fachbereichen abstimmen.


BENEFITS

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Homeoffice: Individuelle Lösungen, die sowohl den Arbeitsabläufen als auch den persönlichen Bedürfnissen gerecht werden.  
  • Mobilität: Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Company Bike, Dienstwagen und Carsharing 
  • Sportangebote: Vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club oder EGYM Wellpass, Teamfit Challenge  
  • Onboarding & Weiterbildungsangebote: umfassendes Onboarding, inklusive Onboarding-Event in Hamburg und vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten 
  • Building Teams: Firmen- und Teamevents, Skifreizeit  
  • Unterstützung in allen Lebenslagen: pme Familienservice, der in herausfordernden Zeiten unterstützt


KONTAKT

Wiebke Leferink
Recruiting Manager

raw.description:
Übersicht

Do you love traveling and are you ready for new challenges in an ambitious, fast-growing and committed company? Then you've come to the right place!

Start your career with us as:

Junior Backend Engineer (m/f/x)  


Was Du bei uns machst

Travelcircus is seeking a Junior Backend Engineer (m/f/x) to join the development team. We're looking for someone who's passionate about building robust & scalable technology platforms, systems and APIs. You'll be an integral part of the engineering team and will work closely with others throughout our company to deliver the best possible product to our customers. Ideal candidates will have experience with PHP, API development and Service-Oriented Architectures.


Deine Verantwortung bei Travelcircus

  • Building and extending our Platform Services and Booking Systems
  • Designing, developing, and maintaining a robust transactional API platform, that will be used internally and directly by 3rd parties
  • Participating in code reviews and pair programming
  • Improving our existing platform codebase which is used by tens of thousands of users on a daily basis
  • Addressing bugs and performance issues


Das kannst Du von uns erwarten

  • FLEXIBLE WORKING HOURS thanks to part-time and flexitime models as well as remote work
  • ATTRACTIVE WORK ENVIRONMENT in a stylish loft office with start-up flair, cooking together, fun & cohesion in a varied working environment and regular team events
  • TRANSPARENT COMMUNICATION thanks to flat hierarchies, fixed feedback cycles and weekly company and team meetings
  • OPTIMAL CAREER OPPORTUNITIES thanks to a comprehensive onboarding program and individual induction, continuous on-the-job training, optimal promotion and further development opportunities 
  • ADDITIONAL COMPENSATION & DISCOUNT on the BVG company ticket (local public transport) and discounts with over 800 other providers
  • PERSONAL TRAVEL BUDGET of €1080 per year to spend freely on our entire product portfolio
  • WORK LIFE BALANCE with 28 vacation days, increasing per year of service, with up to 35 days of vacation entitlement as well as company health management and a pension plan


Das wünschen wir uns von Dir

  • Experience building web applications and distributed web services
  • Knowledge of PHP / OOP, relational databases and data modelling
  • Good understanding of SQL and the ability to write and debug queries
  • Experience with Linux/macOS command line
  • Experience using message queues and Elasticsearch is a plus
  • Strong visual, verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience working in Agile environments


Hast Du noch Fragen oder willst Du dich gleich bewerben?

If you want to develop yourself further and take on responsibility, then you've come to the right place. Please send us your application, including your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date, exclusively via our online application system. 

Our Team Lead People & Operations will be happy to answer any questions you may have:

Ines Krawczyk

Team Travelcircus

Over the past few years,  Travelcircus  has developed into an international company with over 100 highly motivated and committed employees who form the basis of our success. If you would like to get to know our team, then take a look at our Instagram Career page  - there you will get a first impression of your future colleagues. 

We expressly declare that we welcome everyone, regardless of gender, nationality or ethnic origin, religion or ideology, disability, age or sexual identity.

We look forward to meeting you!

Mach mit!

Während des Studiums praktische Erfahrung in einem internationalen B2B-SaaS-Umfeld sammeln und gleichzeitig lernen, wie moderne Support-Prozesse mit digitalen Tools und AI effizienter gestaltet werden? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle im Supplier Sustainability Support (m/w/d) genau passend. 

In dieser Rolle unterstützt du Lieferant und B2B-Nutzer bei ihren Anfragen, sorgst für klare Kommunikation auf Deutsch, Englisch und weiteren Sprachen und hilfst dabei, Support-Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln. Dabei erhältst du Einblicke in Nachhaltigkeit, Produkt-Compliance und digitale Lieferkettenprozesse und arbeitest in einem internationalen Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam dazulernt. 

Wir freuen uns auf dich!


Was erwartet dich?

  • Unterstützung von Lieferanten und B2B-Nutzern bei Support-Anfragen rund um unsere Plattform
  • Schriftliche Beantwortung von Anfragen auf verschiedenen Sprachen – klar, sorgfältig und serviceorientiert
  • Erkennen wiederkehrender Fragen, Bedienfehler oder Prozesslücken und Weitergabe relevanter Erkenntnisse ans Team
  • Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung und Dokumentation von Support-Prozessen
  • Unterstützung bei digitalen und AI-gestützten Prozessverbesserungen
  • Flexible Mitarbeit dort, wo im Team zusätzliche Kapazitätgebrauchtwird


Was solltest du mitbringen?

Erfahrung & fachlicher Fokus 

  • Laufendes Studium an einer staatlich anerkannten Hochschule in Deutschland
  • Verfügbarkeit von 20 Stunden pro Woche in der Vorlesungszeit
  • Idealerweise noch mindestens 1,5 Jahre Studienzeit
  • Interesse an Nachhaltigkeit, Lieferketten, ESG, digitalen Plattformen oder B2B-Kommunikation
  • Erste praktische Erfahrung im B2B-Umfeld, SaaS oder mit digitalen Tools ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung

Technische / methodische Kompetenzen 

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools und Bereitschaft, neue Systeme schnell kennenzulernen
  • Fähigkeit, Informationen strukturiert zu erfassen, sauber zu dokumentieren und zuverlässig weiterzuverarbeiten
  • Sorgfältige Arbeitsweise mit Blick für sprachliche Genauigkeit, klare Formulierungen und Details
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit AI-Tools, Prozessautomatisierung oder Support-Systemen sind hilfreich, aber kein Muss

Arbeitsweise & Mindset 

  • Freude daran, Neues zu lernen und sich in neue Technologien und Prozesse einzuarbeiten
  • Zuverlässige, genaue und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Teamorientierung und Bereitschaft, dort zu unterstützen, wo gerade Hilfegebrauchtwird
  • Konzentration und Sorgfalt auch bei wiederkehrenden oder kleinteiligen Aufgaben
  • Serviceorientierte Haltung und der Anspruch, Nutzer wirklich weiterzuhelfen

Kommunikation & Zusammenarbeit 

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus
  • Freundliche, klare und professionelle Kommunikation mit B2B-Nutzer
  • Freude am Austausch mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Ländern und Unternehmenskontexten
  • Offenheit für Feedback und Spaß daran, gemeinsam mit dem Team bessere Lösungen zu entwickeln


Was bieten wir dir?

  • Spannende Aufgaben mit Sinn: Eine Tätigkeit, die nicht nur Spaß macht, sondern auch echte Bedeutung hat – kombiniert mit hervorragenden Verdienstmöglichkeiten

  • 5+ year of closing experience in technology SaaS sales at enterprise level

  • Self driven – you don’t need someone to motivate you to put in your best every day

title: Fullstack Developer (m/f/d) System Modernization & Strategic Delivery

The ideal candidate is a proactive, DevOps-minded collaborator who can drive solutions from strategic design to automated, continuous deployment. Join our team and apply today on a 100% Remote-Basis as Fullstack Developer (m/f/d) System Modernization & Strategic Delivery! Build and evolve dynamic, scalable user interfaces using Angular and PrimeNG . Implement a comprehensive testing strategy, including Playwright E2E testing. Own and optimize our automated CI/CD pipelines (ideally GitLab CI/CD ). Expertise in defining architectural patterns (e.g., Microservices, Layered Architecture) that facilitate system modernization while ensuring seamless integration with existing core Java and legacy systems. Design Documentation: Skilled in creating clear architectural documentation, flowcharts, and technical specifications to align development teams and stakeholders. Spring Framework & Modernization : Solid experience building enterprise-level applications using the Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data). RESTful APIs & OpenAPI Specification: Strong ability to design, develop, and consume RESTful APIs . Extensive experience defining and documenting APIs using the OpenAPI Specification (Swagger) . Frontend Mastery: Angular & UI/UX Evolution Angular Expertise & UI/UX Evolution : Master-level proficiency in designing and building highly dynamic, responsive, and performant user interfaces using Angular. Proven ability to customize, extend, and optimize components, contributing to a reusable component library. API Integration & OpenAPI Proficiency: Strong capability in consuming and integrating with complex RESTful APIs . Utilizing OpenAPI Specifications (Swagger) for efficient API understanding and integration. Quality & DevOps Automation Automated Testing Full-Stack Testing Strategy: Expertise in implementing a comprehensive testing pyramid, including unit, integration, and end-to-end (E2E) tests. E2E Testing with Playwright: Strong, hands-on experience designing and implementing reliable and fast End-to-End tests using Playwright for cross-browser validation of the Angular application and its integration with the backend APIs. Backend Quality: Proficient in writing high-coverage unit and integration tests for Java/Spring services. Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) CI/CD Pipeline Expertise: Deep understanding of Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment best practices, focusing on automation, quality gates, and rapid delivery. GitLab CI/CD Implementation : Hands-on experience designing, maintaining, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines, ideally using GitLab CI/CD , to automate building, testing, artifact creation, security scanning, and deployment across multiple environments. Mindset & Collaboration Proactive & Collaborative Mindset : We expect a highly proactive and contributing individual who takes initiative to identify architectural challenges, propose innovative full-stack solutions, and actively participate in all phases of the development lifecycle. End-to-End Ownership : Ability to take complete ownership of features, spanning both the client-side and server-side implementations, ensuring a cohesive and high-quality final product delivered through an automated pipeline. Du analysierst Kundenanforderungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Kunden passende Lösungs- und Umsetzungskonzepte. Du führst Workshops durch, dokumentierst Anforderungen und koordinierst deren Umsetzung. Du übernimmst die Steuerung von Projektplänen, Meilensteinen, Ressourcen und Risiken. description: Who we are JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business. From the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events, and best-selling console games. Not only are we entertainment obsessives ourselves, but we also own the world's largest streaming guide, which gives us unparalleled data and insights on audience behaviours and content tastes. From a small startup, we've evolved into a 200+ strong team, based in Berlin, around the world, or working remotely. We've been all about building a profitable business while riding that wave of impressive growth. Who we need Our Campaign team consists of more than 75+ specialists - and it keeps growing: As our new Senior Campaign Analyst , you are the go-to person for all kinds of data-related requests, reports, and their automation. Your expertise will ensure that our campaigns are fueled by accurate data, actionable insights, and efficient reporting processes. Learn where your talents can be developed, deliver at your peak, and create value in your work. Join us and experience a workplace that's the perfect fit for your talent. What you will be doing Collaborate with our Business Intelligence department to maintain correct and clearly defined data and KPIs in campaign dashboards. Stay informed about exceptions made for different clients, reflecting them in reports and analyses. Accelerate the reporting process for the campaigns team. Design and provide dashboards, along with data for weekly and monthly reports. Ensure data sanity in our tools, Thoughtspot/Lightdash, and maintain data quality in external dashboards. Proactively detect the optimisation potential in our media campaigns. Conducting benchmarking and forecasting activities. What we need from you Proven experience in marketing analytics or a related field, with a deep understanding of business models and digital marketing channels. Deep understanding of the channels we use (Meta, TikTok, DV360) and their relevant KPIs, including their definition. Strong analytical skills and the ability to derive actionable insights from complex datasets, KPIs, and benchmarks. Exceptional skills in Excel and Google Spreadsheets, with the ability to quickly set up reports with data from various sources efficiently. Excellent communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders effectively, and simplify complex scenarios, bringing clarity and focus. Ability to remain composed and deliver error-free reports and dashboards even in high-pressure, stressful situations with tight deadlines, when faced with obstacles. Constant learning, delivering results, and creating value are the core characteristics of everyone at JustWatch, and we are looking for these values in every person we hire. What we offer you An open-minded and international team that loves to collaborate to reach our goals. We prioritise meaningful work over perks, and that true fulfilment comes from intrinsic motivation, personal growth, and making a lasting impact. We believe in a permission-less environment that lets us focus on delivering value without overcomplicating things. We trust our skilled professionals to maintain a no-nonsense attitude and create an environment that promotes innovation. We are committed to helping you achieve your personal and professional goals, and we offer a collaborative and supportive environment to do so. Truly a hybrid work environment. title: Working Student Risk (f/m/x)
description: About lemon.markets 🍋 We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses, providing seamless access to capital markets. By empowering FinTechs, Banks and Wealth Managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers. lemon.markets provides a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform for simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure makes launching an investment product customer-centric and compliant. We abstract all complexity for our partners through a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal and operating in a clear regulatory framework. Enabling partners to launch in weeks, not months. We have experienced first-hand that brokerage infrastructure is broken. Building an investment product used to be highly expensive, challenging and cumbersome. We ease this pain by shielding our partners & their customers from the underlying complexity - and with that, we make investing seamlessly accessible to everyone. Because that’s exactly what we enjoy, going to places nobody else dares and solving hard problems. This not only creates tons of value when done right, but attracts the smartest minds - because outlier companies are built by exceptional people like you. Your mission: We are looking for a Working Student in Risk (f/m/x) to help us with our daily risk management tasks. This includes topics like operational and financial/ non‑financial risks, internal controls, and audit support. You will collect and organise information, analyse data, and support us in making our processes more automated and efficient. In this role, you get real hands‑on experience in how risk management works inside a regulated fintech. You’ll support both small projects and everyday tasks to help keep our risk management and audit processes running smoothly. You will work closely with the Risk team, and cross-functional with Tech, Product, Operations, Finance and Compliance. title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce)
description: Deine Mission Alle reden über AI. Wir entscheiden, wie sie im Unternehmen wirklich eingesetzt wird. Ein 400-Milliarden-Dollar-Markt. Ein profitables Scale-up, das ihn mit AI und einem globalen Freelancer-Netzwerk neu denkt. Und mittendrin ein Team, das nicht primär Code schreibt, sondern entscheidet, was AI im Unternehmen bewirken soll - für mehr als 25.000 Talents in über 70 Ländern, durch Automatisierung und intelligente Prozesse. Wir suchen dich als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce) in unserem Headquarter in München -Schwabing für unsere cross-funktionale strategische Taskforce. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Strategy, Business und AI - als Sparringspartner:in für AI Engineers, Product- und Operations-Expert:innen sowie eine ehemalige BCG-Beraterin. Nicht als zusätzliche:r Engineer im Team, sondern als die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das Team das Richtige baut. Das ist keine klassische Werkstudentenstelle für Techies. Du strukturierst Probleme, baust Business Cases, bewertest AI-Anwendungen aus Business-Perspektive und übersetzt zwischen dem, was technisch möglich ist, und dem, was strategisch sinnvoll ist. Die Konzepte, an denen du arbeitest, landen nicht in einer Schublade - sie fließen direkt in Entscheidungen unseres Leadership-Teams ein. Was du wirklich machst AI-Strategie statt AI-Code: Du arbeitest an strategischen AI-Initiativen wie unserem Talent Assistant oder AutoQA 2.0 (KI-basierte Voice-File-Analyse) mit - nicht als Entwickler:in, sondern als jemand, der Anforderungen strukturiert, Prioritäten setzt und aus ersten Ideen belastbare Feature-Konzepte macht. Die technische Umsetzung übernehmen unsere AI Engineers; du sorgst dafür, dass sie das Richtige bauen. Aus Ideen werden Entscheidungen: Du analysierst komplexe Fragestellungen, baust Business Cases nach klassischer Case-Logik auf und entwickelst Entscheidungsgrundlagen für unser Leadership-Team. Deine Analysen beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche AI-Initiativen umgesetzt werden. AI braucht Struktur: Große Sprachmodelle sind nur so gut wie die Daten dahinter. Du definierst Kompetenzframeworks und Bewertungslogiken, die unsere AI-Systeme intelligenter machen - die inhaltliche Logik, nicht die technische Implementierung. Eigene Projekte mit echtem Ownership: Du übernimmst eigenständig Themen von der ersten Analyse bis zum ersten Konzept - ein neuer AI-Use-Case, ein Workflow, der heute noch manuell läuft, eine Automatisierung, ein neuer Lösungsansatz. Der Inhalt wechselt, der Anspruch nicht: Du bekommst Verantwortung, nicht nur Aufgaben. Dort arbeiten, wo gerade der größte Hebel liegt: Du unterstützt unser Team dort, wo aktuell die spannendsten strategischen Fragestellungen entstehen. Das bedeutet Abwechslung, hohe Geschwindigkeit und sichtbaren Impact. Warum diese Rolle dich außergewöhnlich schnell wachsen lässt Hier lernst du nicht programmieren - du lernst, wie man AI-Investitionen bewertet, Business Cases baut, die vor Geschäftsführung und Leadership bestehen, und komplexe Themen so strukturiert, dass daraus messbarer Business Impact entsteht. Genau das Handwerk, das du später in der Strategieberatung oder im Corporate Strategy-Umfeld brauchst - nur, dass die Empfehlung hier real umgesetzt wird und nicht in einer Präsentation endet. Du arbeitest eng mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin sowie AI Engineers und Product-Expert:innen zusammen und bewegst dich täglich zwischen Strategie, Business Judgement und AI. Die letzte Werkstudentin ist anschließend als Trainee bei uns eingestiegen - nicht, weil wir es versprechen, sondern weil sie während ihrer Zeit bei uns bereits Verantwortung übernommen hat. Dein Skillset Akademischer Hintergrund: Du studierst aktuell im Master (BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar) und bringst bereits erste praktische Erfahrung mit - idealerweise mit strategischem oder analytischem Fokus. AI-affin, kein AI Engineer: Du musst nicht coden können und keine Modelle bauen. Aber du nutzt AI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT als Power-User für Recherche, Analyse und Strukturierung - und verstehst, wie AI Geschäftsprozesse verändert. Wichtiger als technisches Tiefenwissen: Du erkennst, welches Problem ein AI-Use-Case eigentlich lösen soll. Fähigkeiten: Du strukturierst komplexe Sachverhalte sauber und nutzt PowerPoint und Excel sicher genug, um überzeugende Management-Präsentationen und Business Cases aufzubereiten. Mindset: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand den nächsten Schritt erklärt. Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein, denkst unternehmerisch und willst Lösungen entwickeln statt Aufgaben abzuarbeiten. Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst und präsentierst in verhandlungssicherem Deutsch und Englisch und verfügst natürlich über eine gesunde Portion Humor. Rahmenbedingungen: Du hast 16–20 Stunden pro Woche während des Semesters Kapazität, bei uns vor Ort im Münchner Headquarter tätig zu sein. In der vorlesungsfreien Zeit flexibel bis Vollzeit möglich. Dein Winning Deal Deine Chance: Vom ersten Tag an arbeitest du an einer der strategisch wichtigsten AI-Initiativen unseres Unternehmens mit und gestaltest Lösungen, die den Arbeitsalltag tausender Menschen verbessern können. Dein Buddy: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin, die dich individuell begleitet und fordert. Dein Netzwerk: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit AI Engineers, Product-, Strategy- und Operations-Expert:innen - Einblicke, die klassische Werkstudentenstellen selten bieten. Deine Perspektive: Ein anschließender Einstieg als Trainee ist ausdrücklich möglich und in unserem Team bereits mehrfach Realität geworden. Deine Benefits: Neben weekly Pizza und Snacks vor Ort, bieten wir dir außerdem einen Joblunch-Zuschuss (4 x 6,90 € im Monat), eine bezuschusste Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits" sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents. Dein Arbeitsplatz: Flexibles, hybrides Arbeitsmodell in einem unserer modernen, hundefreundlichen Büros. Dein Beitrag: Eine Position in einem profitablen Unternehmen, in dem du die Freiheit und das Vertrauen hast, mitzugestalten und mit uns an der „Future of Work" zu arbeiten. Unsere Werte: Eine offene, authentische Kultur und ein leistungsstarkes, humorvolles Team, das sich darauf freut, gemeinsam mit dir mutige Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Wege zu gehen. title: Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Skalierung braucht ein Fundament, das mitwächst. Über unsere Plattform laufen täglich Interaktionen von mehr als 25.000 Talents in 70+ Ländern, und mit unserem Wachstumsziel von 500 Mio. € Umsatz bis 2030 steigt der Anspruch an unsere Cloud-Platform, Deployment-Prozesse und Kosteneffizienz kontinuierlich. Als Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) im hybriden Modell an einem unserer Standorte in München, Berlin oder Halle (Saale) verantwortest du unsere Cloud Platform, primär auf Microsoft Azure. Du entscheidest, wie wir Infrastruktur designen, betreiben und optimieren, mit klarem Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du unsere CI/CD-Plattform und Self-Service-Tools weiter, die unseren Engineering-Teams schnelleres und sichereres Deployment ermöglichen. Deine Aufgaben Cloud Platform & Developer Enablement Azure Platform Ownership: Du verantwortest Design, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, von Compute und Networking bis Identity und Governance. Infrastructure as Code statt Klick-Administration: Du entwickelst und pflegst IaC mit Terraform, stellst wiederverwendbare Module bereit und automatisierst, was manuell fehleranfällig wäre. CI/CD-Plattform kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln: Du automatisierst Deployments über den gesamten Software-Lifecycle und baust Self-Service-Plattformen, die Dev-Teams eigenständiger machen. Developer Experience mitdenken: Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Product zusammen, um Delivery-Prozesse und Plattform-Fähigkeiten laufend zu verbessern. Platform Reliability, Security & Cost Efficiency Platform Reliability im Blick: Du monitorst Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität und gehst Infrastruktur- und Deployment-Probleme proaktiv an, bevor sie zum Incident werden. Security by Design: Gemeinsam mit unserem CISO-Team integrierst du Security Controls direkt in Plattform und CI/CD-Prozesse, inklusive Azure Security Services, Policies und Benchmarks. Kosteneffizienz als Designprinzip: Du optimierst Infrastruktur und Deployment-Plattformen konsequent auf Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Kosten, von Anfang an statt nachträglich. FinOps in der Praxis: Du baust Cloud-Cost-Monitoring, Budgeting und Forecasting auf und lieferst konkrete Empfehlungen zur laufenden Kostenoptimierung. Dein Skillset Cloud Platform: Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure in Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity und Governance, plus Verständnis von Cloud-Architektur-Prinzipien auch über Azure hinaus. Automation: Routiniert mit Terraform, Bicep oder ARM, CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI/CD oder vergleichbaren Tools produktiv aufgebaut, Configuration Management automatisiert statt manuell gepflegt. Container & Scripting: Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes/Nomad oder Azure ACA/ACI, sichere Scripting-Skills in Python, PowerShell oder Bash. Observability & Security: Monitoring, Logging und Alerting im Alltag, angewandtes Verständnis von IAM, RBAC, Zero Trust und Privileged Identity Management, praktische Erfahrung mit GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 oder PCI DSS. FinOps: Cloud-Usage-Analyse, Ressourcenoptimierung und kosteneffiziente Architekturen als Teil deines Designs, nicht als Nachgedanke. Azure-Zertifizierungen, FinOps-Frameworks, Serverless-Architekturen oder Erfahrung mit verteilten oder hybriden Systemen sind ein Plus. Arbeitsweise: Analytisches, lösungsorientiertes Denken, Eigenverantwortung im interdisziplinären Umfeld, klare Kommunikation mit technischen wie nichttechnischen Stakeholdern, fließendes Englisch und eine gesunde Portion Humor. Dein Winning Deal Die Werte: Wir punkten mit einer offenen, authentischen Kultur und einem leistungsstarken sowie humorvollen Team, das sich schon jetzt darauf freut, mit dir mutige Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Wege zu gehen, die uns zu nachhaltigen Erfolgen führen. Dein Footprint: Eine Position in einer profitablen Company, in der deine Infrastruktur-Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss auf Skalierung und Kosten haben, nicht nur auf dem Papier. Deine Chance: Bei uns hast du vom ersten Tag an die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Innovationen voranzutreiben und gemeinsam mit einem Team aus Expert:innen das Unternehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Benefits: Neben 30 Tagen Urlaub bieten wir dir außerdem einen "Joblunch"-Zuschuss (69 € im Monat), eine "Givve"-Card (wird monatlich mit 50 € aufgeladen) oder alternativ eine bezuschusste "Wellpass" Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits", die Möglichkeit eines "JobRad"-Leasings, Zuschüsse zur Altersvorsorge (bAV & VL) sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents. Dein Arbeitsplatz: Bei uns arbeitest du im flexiblen, hybriden Modell aus einem unserer hundefreundlichen und modernen Offices und hast zudem die Möglichkeit auf 2 Wochen im Jahr Workation innerhalb der EU (*gilt nur für Mitarbeiter:innen mit EU-Pass). title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Foundational Representations
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://redditinc.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p><strong>Location: </strong>Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands.</p> <p>The <strong>Ads Foundational Representations (AFR)</strong> team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Multimodal &amp; Content Embeddings</strong> - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Contextual and Behavioral Relevance </strong>- Working with Product &amp; Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge Graph Embeddings - </strong>Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting &amp; business insights.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>User Intent Modeling -</strong> Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch &amp; real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>LLM-based Representations</strong> - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes</li> </ul> <p>The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.</p> <p>As a <strong>Staff ML Engineer</strong>, you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution.&nbsp;</p> <p>Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy &amp; designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis &amp; engineering, modeling &amp; automation).&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Providing technical leadership and mentorship to MLEs in the team: driving designs &amp; their review, establishing best practices in analysis, modeling and engineering, keeping the bar high.&nbsp;</li> <li>Working closely with team/org leadership developing technical strategy for content-based embeddings &amp; relevance for Ads.</li> <li>Developing new or iterating on existing embedding models for advertising use cases, ranging from aggregation pipelines to two-tower architectures and sequence models.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings.&nbsp;</li> <li>Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop.&nbsp;</li> <li>Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the various features we develop, end-to-end experimentation from internal benchmarks to downstream recommender system offline metrics to online experiments.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ML systems by writing automated tests, monitoring performance, and implementing best practices for model management.</li> <li>Participating in modeling and coding reviews: You will review work by other team members and provide feedback to ensure that it meets the team's standards for quality and performance.</li> <li>Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models.</li> <li>Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving standards and bar raising, leading complex cross-functional projects: from requirements, design to cross-team/functional alignment and execution without direct people-management authority.&nbsp;</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to different audiences, both verbally and in writing.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong track record of working on content rich NLP/CV problems at scale, and using embeddings as a tool to solve them.&nbsp;</li> <li>Established data-driven approach for ML system development. Excitement about working with data and readiness to look behind the metric numbers.&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with the Ads domain and/or Search/Recommender systems.</li> <li>Experience with mainstream DL frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with our stack (Python, Pytorch, Airflow, BigQuery, Ray, k8s, kafka, GCP)</li> <li>Tech leadership experience: mentoring junior engineers and leading complex projects.&nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on experience with using/fine-tuning/building LLMs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li> <li>Family Planning Support</li> <li>Gender-Affirming Care</li> <li>Mental Health &amp; Coaching Benefits</li> <li>Group Personal Pension Scheme with Employer match</li> <li>Private Medical and Dental Scheme</li> <li>Income Replacement Programs</li> <li>Bike to Work scheme</li> <li>Flexible Vacation &amp; Paid Volunteer Time Off</li> <li>Generous Paid Parental Leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.&nbsp; We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.&nbsp; We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.&nbsp; For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our <a href="https://redditinc.com/policies/candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors</a>.</span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.&nbsp; Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.</span></em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><strong>Life at THG Beauty&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.</p> <p>By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin,&nbsp;with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.</p> <p>THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.&nbsp;</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be a <span class="TextRun MacChromeBold SCXW257253422 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW257253422 BCX8">Senior Social Executive</span></span> at THG Beauty?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As Senior Social Executive, you will play a key role in shaping and executing our social media strategy across multiple platforms. We move fast, challenge convention, and back ourselves to win. These values shape how we work every day.</p> <p data-start="580" data-end="776"><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p data-start="580" data-end="776"></p> <p>We are looking to hire a Senior Events Manager to join our Brand Marketing team at Myprotein, the world’s largest online sports nutrition brand. In this senior role, you’ll take ownership of our end-to-end events strategy – leading a dynamic events calendar from concept through delivery, managing and developing a team of event professionals, and setting the standard for high-impact, brand-defining activations. With a strong focus on B2B and influencer-led events, you’ll build and maintain relationships with senior industry partners, stakeholders, and clients, shaping how the brand shows up at every touchpoint. You’ll partner closely with senior leadership, internal teams, and external partners to translate business objectives into bold event concepts delivered at scale.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Events and Activations strategy &amp; calendar ownership</li> <li>Team leadership, coaching &amp; development</li> <li>Budget ownership per activation</li> <li>Senior stakeholder &amp; leadership engagement</li> <li>Supplier &amp; vendor negotiation at scale</li> <li>B2B &amp; flagship event execution</li> <li>On-site event leadership</li> <li>Speaker, talent &amp; influencer partnerships (in collaboration with the influencer team)</li> <li>Brand direction for event materials &amp; creative</li> <li>Multi-market event roll-out</li> <li>Logistics, scheduling &amp; risk management</li> <li>Permits, compliance &amp; health and safety</li> <li>Post-event reporting, ROI analysis &amp; insight sharing</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Look For your Skills, Knowledge and Experience:</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Events Manager who leads from the front – someone who thrives under pressure, is energised by a fast-paced environment, and brings both strategic thinking and hands-on delivery to everything they do. You’ll have a sharp eye for industry trends, a track record of developing others, and the confidence to represent the brand in front of senior stakeholders.</p> <ul> <li>Experience: 5 years of event management experience, including experience operating at a senior or leadership level, ideally within a brand marketing, retail, or corporate environment.</li> <li>Brand Events: Proven track record delivering large-scale, influencer-focused and PR-driven events (e.g. global brand launches, PR previews, creator activations) end-to-end.</li> <li>Project Management: Proven ability to manage multiple complex, high-profile events simultaneously, from concept to execution.</li> <li>Stakeholder Management: Confident operating with senior stakeholders, internal teams, external partners, and description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><strong>Life at THG Beauty&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.</p> <p>By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin,&nbsp;with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.</p> <p>THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.</p> <p><strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">About Cult Beauty&nbsp;<br></span></strong></p> <p>Cult Beauty is one of the UK's leading online beauty destinations, known for a curated, expert-led edit of the best emerging and established beauty brands. As part of THG, Cult Beauty combines an entrepreneurial, fast-moving culture with the scale, data and technology of a global e-commerce group. The affiliates and partnerships channel is a genuine growth priority for the business, with strong performance to date and significant headroom to scale reach, revenue and brand awareness over the next 12–24 months.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be a Senior Affiliates &amp; Partnerships Manager at THG Beauty?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Affiliates &amp; Partnerships Manager to take ownership of Cult Beauty's affiliate channel and lead its next phase of growth. This is a hands-on role; you'll set the strategy and own the numbers. You will also be in the detail, planning activations, negotiating placements, managing budgets in real time, and reporting on performance. It suits someone who is equally comfortable building a forecast model as they are briefing a publisher or optimising a live campaign.</p> <p>You'll own the channel's budget end-to-end, from annual and quarterly planning and forecasting through to in-month tracking, reforecasting and reconciliation against actuals, while also executing the campaigns and activations that bring the strategy to life. You'll use data, including media mix modelling (MMM) and other cross-channel measurement, to understand the channel's true incremental contribution and its role in the wider marketing mix, and you'll look for opportunities for the channel to support broader brand awareness goals, not just direct performance.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">As </span><em><span data-contrast="auto"> Senior Affiliates &amp; Partnerships Manager</span></em><span data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;you’ll:&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1}">&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Channel strategy &amp; scale</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the affiliate and partnerships strategy for Cult Beauty, identifying and prioritising the highest-value opportunities to scale reach, revenue and new customer acquisition.</li> <li>Build the channel out from its current base, expanding the partner mix across content, cashback, loyalty, influencer-affiliate and technology partners, while protecting margin and brand value.</li> <li>Identify and develop opportunities for the channel to support wider brand awareness objectives, working with brand and content teams to use partnerships (e.g. content, video and influencer-affiliate placements) to build reach and consideration alongside direct performance.</li> <li>Keep the channel's commercial model, commission structure and partner tiering under continuous review, benchmarking against market practice.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Budget planning, forecasting &amp; management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead annual and quarterly budget planning and revenue/commission forecasting for the channel, working closely with finance and the wider marketing leadership team.</li> <li>Own in-month budget management and pacing, tracking spend and commission against forecast, reforecasting as needed, and flagging variances before they become a problem.</li> <li>Build and maintain robust forecasting models that link activity, seasonality and commercial terms to expected return, and use these to make the case for investment.</li> <li>Apply media mix modelling (MMM) outputs and other cross-channel measurement to inform budget allocation, understand the channel's incremental contribution, and stress-test planning assumptions against the wider marketing mix.</li> <li>Reconcile monthly performance against budget and finance records, ensuring accurate, timely reporting on channel P&amp;L.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Activation execution &amp; campaign management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Plan and execute the affiliate activation calendar, from always-on placements through to peak trading moments (e.g. Black Friday, Cyber Monday, key beauty launches) and brand awareness activity.</li> <li>Brief, negotiate and manage relationships with affiliate networks, publishers, content creators and technology partners to secure high-quality, cost-effective placements.</li> <li>Own day-to-day channel operations: commission structuring, tracking and validation, compliance, and troubleshooting technical or performance issues.</li> <li>Use AI-driven tools and optimization, for example automated bid/commission optimisation, AI-assisted content, creative or audience targeting to improve campaign efficiency and free up time for strategic activity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data, insight &amp; reporting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Use data to drive decisions across the channel, analysing performance by partner, placement and campaign to identify what's working and reallocate budget accordingly.</li> <li>Own regular and ad hoc reporting for senior stakeholders, translating channel performance into clear commercial insight and recommendations.</li> <li>Partner with wider analytics/BI teams to improve attribution, measurement and incrementality understanding for the channel.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership &amp; collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, coach and develop the affiliates team, setting clear priorities and creating capacity to scale as the channel grows.</li> <li>Act as the primary point of contact for the affiliates channel with cross-functional teams, including brand, finance and commercial, ensuring alignment on priorities and investment.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with other marketing channels, including paid social, PR, influencer and CRM to align messaging, avoid duplication of partner relationships, and ensure affiliate activity is planned as part of an integrated, cross-channel marketing calendar.</li> <li>Represent Cult Beauty externally with networks, agencies and partners, building a reputation as a commercially sharp, collaborative partner.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What skills and experience do I need for this role?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience managing an affiliate/partnerships channel in a fast-paced e-commerce, retail or beauty environment, ideally at Manager level or above already.</li> <li>Strong data acumen: confident building and interrogating models in Excel/Google Sheets, comfortable working across GA4/BI tools and media mix modelling (MMM) or cross-channel measurement outputs, and able to translate data into a clear commercial story.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience owning a budget end-to-end: annual/quarterly planning and forecasting through to in-month management, pacing and reconciliation with finance.</li> <li>Hands-on experience planning and executing affiliate activations and campaigns, not just overseeing them but comfortable being close to the detail.</li> <li>Working knowledge of affiliate networks and tracking platforms (e.g. Awin, Rakuten Advertising, Partnerize, Impact, CJ) and the wider creator-commerce landscape.</li> <li>Comfortable using AI and automation tools to optimise campaigns, spend and content at scale, and keen to test new tools as the affiliate/AI-commerce landscape evolves.</li> <li>Strong commercial and negotiation skills, with experience managing partner and network relationships.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work confidently across teams and influence senior stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in beauty, fashion or a related lifestyle retail category.</li> <li>Experience scaling a channel or building out a partner programme from a smaller base.</li> <li>Familiarity with media mix modelling (MMM), attribution or incrementality methodologies and testing frameworks.</li> <li>Experience using partnerships or affiliate activity to support brand awareness and upper-funnel objectives, alongside performance/direct-response activity.</li> <li>Line management or mentoring experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You are</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analytical and commercially minded, with genuine curiosity about what the numbers are telling you.</li> <li>Organised and comfortable owning a budget with real accountability for the numbers.</li> <li>A doer as well as a strategist, happy to plan the activation and then get it live.</li> <li>A natural collaborator who builds trust quickly with partners and colleagues across the wider business.<br> <p>&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <p>This role is based in our London office, with a minimum of three days a week on site. You'll collaborate with colleagues in our Manchester office as needed, with occasional travel between sites.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What’s in it for me?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p>
