description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Business Development Executive</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:&nbsp;</strong>Sydney (hybrid working)&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Axiom:</strong></p> <p><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">As the leading alternative legal services provider globally,&nbsp;</span><a href="https://www.axiomlaw.com/" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-outlook-id="f2cfc5ca-ba3e-47dd-8d11-b247352d64eb" data-linkindex="0">Axiom</a>&nbsp;gives in-house legal teams on-demand access to top legal talent and lawyers — deployed when, where, and how clients need it, for up to 50% less than national law firms. Axiom's network of 14,000+ legal professionals includes 4,000+ lawyers with Fortune 500 experience, delivering AI-enabled legal services across more than 12 practice areas. Trusted by 75% of the Fortune 100 and thousands of mid-market leaders, Axiom ranks #1 among Alternative Legal Service Providers in 8 of 9 performance categories — including talent quality, breadth, productivity, and client experience — according to a top 5 global consulting firm. Across more than 3,000 engagements annually in 6 regions and 4 continents, 93% of clients rate Axiom lawyers as good as or better than top law firm attorneys, with 96% client satisfaction and measurable cost savings that reduce outside counsel spend without sacrificing quality. Stop overpaying for law firm work.&nbsp;<strong>Start with Axiom.</strong></p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>As we continue our expansion, we’re looking for a team member who can share Axiom’s story with prospective clients and set up revenue-generating meeting opportunities for the sales team. This is a position for an aspiring sales professional who is excited to jump-start their career as a Business Development Representative. Our ideal candidate is someone who loves to connect with sophisticated stakeholders, exhibits outstanding judgment, maturity, confidence, and professionalism, and thrives in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment within a close-knit team.</p> <p>Specifically, this role will be responsible for:</p> <ul> <li>Strategically researching/identifying potential client contacts, generating leads, and uncovering high-value opportunities</li> <li>Communicating Axiom’s business model to potential clients in an impactful way and demonstrating why a meeting with Axiom would be beneficial to their business</li> <li>Driving business through outbound phone calls, preparing and sending strategic e-mails to prospective clients specific to their business or legal needs</li> <li>Successfully diagnosing the client’s key business needs to ensure a high quality of interaction in the first sales meeting</li> <li>Supporting Sales in all aspects of the sales cycle, including scheduling follow-up meetings and managing the pipelines of completed meetings to ensure all prospective clients are being contacted throughout the year</li> <li>Working with local and central marketing teams to create external marketing materials to engage prospective clients.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>About you:</strong></p> <p>First and foremost, successful candidates must be fits for our unique operating environment and culture: high-growth, innovative, lean, and values-driven.&nbsp; As such, successful candidates must be ready to develop professionally, serious about pursuing a career in sales, and highly capable in each the following dimensions (among others): adaptability, curiosity, resourcefulness, analytical thinking/problem solving, proactivity, taking initiative, teamwork, thought leadership, credibility, and operating with/through a lean team.</p> <p>Beyond these characteristics, here are the required skills, knowledge, capabilities, and education:</p> <ul> <li>Goal and action orientation, with a sense of urgency, drive, and commitment to routinely exceed monthly activity metrics</li> <li>Exemplary service ethic when contributing to individual and team goals</li> <li>Highly persuasive verbal communication skills, and excellent written communication skills</li> <li>Poise, confidence, and maturity to interact with senior client levels</li> <li>Tenacity and resilience with a will to keep going despite rejections</li> <li>Forward-thinking and solutions-oriented approach at all times</li> <li>Strong MS office skills</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree from an accredited school or equivalent experience</li> </ul> <p><strong><br>Our new hires: &nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Receive hands-on coaching from a direct manager and a mentor.</li> <li>Embrace real responsibility: tangible meeting goals, relationships with executive-level clients at Fortune 500 companies, and leadership opportunities.</li> <li>Nurture their ongoing career goals inside of a talent-incubating team that has boasted over 15 promotions in the past 2 years.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Accommodation for Individuals with Disabilities: </strong>Upon request and consistent with applicable laws, Axiom will attempt to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities who require an accommodation to participate in the application process. To request an accommodation to complete the application form, please contact us at <a ---------- and include “Applicant Accommodation” in the subject line.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs spends meaningfully on paid acquisition, and that spend is only as good as the data behind it. We are looking for an engineer to own our measurement layer end to end: the tag manager setup, the tracking and attribution scripts on our sites, and the server-to-server conversion tracking that feeds our ad platforms.

Day to day you will work closely with the paid marketing team: fixing tracking bugs as they come in, setting up tracking for new landing pages and campaigns, and debugging discrepancies between platform-reported conversions and our internal data. Longer term, you will define how tracking should properly work here and build the monitoring so we catch breakage in hours, not weeks.

This role sits between frontend engineering, data engineering, and marketing. You will add and improve tracking scripts without hurting pagespeed, keep our server-side GTM container healthy, make sure consent and regional restrictions are correctly enforced, and ensure the right channels get credit for the right conversions. Your work directly decides how a large paid budget gets allocated.

What you will do

  • Own our tag manager setup end to end, including the server-side GTM container, and review any changes other teams want to make

  • Work with the paid marketing team daily: fix tracking bugs, set up tracking for new landing pages and campaigns, and debug discrepancies between platform-reported conversions and our internal data

  • Build and maintain server-to-server conversion tracking (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, and similar) and validate pixel vs server deduplication

  • Improve tracking script performance and correctness, keeping script impact on pagespeed and Core Web Vitals within budget

  • Make sure consent handling and regional restrictions are correctly enforced across markets

  • Define event schema and UTM conventions, and document them so tracking for new campaigns is correct by default

  • Build monitoring and alerting for the measurement stack so we catch broken tracking within hours, not weeks

  • Review PRs that add conversion events to the main app, and work with product engineering on tracking integrations

Requirements

  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, comfortable working in both frontend code and a production application codebase

  • Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager, including server-side GTM, and at least one conversion API (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or similar) implemented server-to-server

  • Experience debugging attribution discrepancies end to end: pixel vs server deduplication, UTM conventions, event schema design

  • Solid understanding of web performance and how to add tracking without degrading Core Web Vitals

  • Working knowledge of consent and privacy requirements (Consent Mode v2, regional restrictions) and SQL for validating tracking data in the warehouse

Bonus

  • CDP experience (Segment, RudderStack, Snowplow)

  • Product analytics tools (GA4, Amplitude, PostHog) and dbt

  • Next.js experience

  • Exposure to incrementality testing or media mix modelling

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Own the whole martech and measurement area as it grows, potentially leading a small marketing engineering team

  • Grow toward senior/staff IC on the engineering track

  • Broaden into data engineering and attribution modelling, or into growth engineering more widely (experimentation, landing page infrastructure)

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.

You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.

 

This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.

 
 

What You'll Do

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub).

  • Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential

  • Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning

  • Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application

  • Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broader launch

  • Work with Legal to define data usage policies, including restrictions on redistribution, AI training and model embedding, and onward use, protecting 9fin's data IP while enabling legitimate client workflows

Cross-Functional Leadership & GTM

 

  • Coordinate across platform engineering, analytics engineering, domain squads, and the Head of Analytics to align priorities and ship a cohesive product without a dedicated squad

  • Influence teams you do not manage; build relationships that make cross-functional delivery work despite competing priorities

  • Support the shift to a solution-selling GTM motion: work with Sales and Customer Success on partner selection, POC design, technical onboarding, and commercial structuring for API deals

  • Engage directly with enterprise clients and their technical teams during pilots and integrations; this is a client-facing role, not a back-office one

  • Communicate strategy, progress, and trade-offs transparently to leadership, engineering, and commercial teams

  • Translate technical API and data infrastructure concepts into language that non-technical stakeholders (Sales, Legal, Finance) can act on

  • Experience designing APIs for external consumers: you have opinions on schema design, versioning strategies, rate limiting, and what makes developer documentation actually useful

  • Track record of shipping data products where you managed the full lifecycle: from defining what data to expose, through schema design, to commercial packaging and client onboarding

  • Understanding of data infrastructure concepts: data pipelines, warehouses, ETL/ELT, data modelling, and platforms like Snowflake

  • Comfortable with SQL and Python and capable of interrogating data to validate quality, understand usage patterns, and inform product decisions

  • Experience working in a solution-selling or partner-led GTM model: you have been involved in POCs, pilots, or co-development with enterprise clients, not just self-serve product launches

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functionally without a dedicated team: you coordinate across engineering, data, and commercial functions through influence, not authority

  • Strong commercial instinct: you understand how enterprise data buyers evaluate providers, and you can shape a product that competes on data quality, coverage, and ease of integration

  • Clear communicator who can translate between technical and commercial audiences

 

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with credit markets, debt instruments, or how buy-side/sell-side firms consume financial data

  • Experience with Snowflake data sharing, marketplace listings, or similar cloud data distribution mechanisms

  • Experience building entitlements, licensing, or access control systems for data products

  • Understanding of data licensing, redistribution terms, or AI usage policies in the context of enterprise data products

 

Benefits

 

  • Competitive, market-benchmarked salary

  • Pension with 7% company matching

  • Private medical insurance, paid sick leave, income protection, group life assurance

  • Season ticket and cycle-to-work schemes

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About us&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;</h2> <p>Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.&nbsp; Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.</p> <p>Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.&nbsp; Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.&nbsp; <br><br>In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.</p> <p>At Wayve, your contributions matter.&nbsp; We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!&nbsp;&nbsp;</p></div><h2>About The Team</h2> <p>Wayve is building embodied AI that can drive any vehicle, anywhere. Our AI Driver runs on-vehicle in real time, and the <strong>Runtime Platform team</strong> owns the application frameworks, middleware (IPC / inter-process communication), monitoring, performance, and observability foundations that make that possible. This is a growing sub-team that we're breaking out into its own team, and you’ll be the Engineering Manager to lead it.</p> <h2>The role</h2> <p>As Engineering Manager for Runtime Platform, you'll lead a single team and be accountable for its delivery, engagement, resourcing, roadmap, and performance. People leadership is your first priority: you'll coach and grow the team, keep it engaged and high-performing, and own hiring as the team stands up. You'll pair that with strong technical judgment — setting clear technical direction on latency, profiling, real-time scheduling, and middleware, and owning the outcome of the team's technical decisions.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team (first priority):</strong> keep the team engaged, developing, and performing with good morale; run 1:1s, set clear expectations, give regular high-quality feedback, manage performance, and support career growth against our career framework.</li> <li><strong>Hire and build the team:</strong> own hiring and onboarding to get the right people in the right roles, and shape the team's culture and ways of working as it forms.</li> <li><strong>Drive execution:</strong> ensure the team's work advances company goals; staff committed programs, keep the roadmap aligned to available resources, prioritize, and hold the team accountable for delivery, quality, and operational reliability.</li> <li><strong>Set technical direction:</strong> ensure the team has a clear, holistic technical direction and clear ownership of its technology-roadmap milestones — working closely with the team's tech lead(s) and stakeholders; own the outcome of the team's technical decisions.</li> <li><strong>Own the runtime foundations:</strong> guide the team's work across system design, application frameworks, the middleware/IPC layer, performance &amp; optimization, and measurement &amp; observability. Enable new vehicle platform enablement with incremental work and minimal performance degradation. Implement and maintain strong CI, HIL, and internal quality gates to provide a robust framework for fast iteration..</li> <li><strong>Collaborate and unblock:</strong> cascade the roadmap, partner with internal Vehicle Software teams, model developers, hardware, and OEM programs. Act as the point of escalation for your team, and proactively surface and resolve risks and dependencies.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Engineering management experience (essential):</strong> a track record of leading, growing, engaging, and retaining a high-performing software/systems team — including hiring, coaching, feedback, and performance management. People management is your first priority.</li> <li><strong>Delivery through a team:</strong> experience owning a team's roadmap and shipping through others — planning, prioritization, resourcing, and accountability for quality and operational reliability.</li> <li><strong>Technical credibility:</strong> hands-on depth in what takes to architect and deliver embedded software shipped on a product to real customers. Demonstrate knowledge of high-performance, low-latency embedded software (C++) to earn the trust of senior systems engineers and own the team's technical decisions. You don't need to be the team's top individual contributor.</li> <li><strong>Performance &amp; systems fundamentals:</strong> solid understanding of profiling, benchmarking, latency/throughput/memory-bandwidth analysis, and real-time scheduling, on embedded Linux (ideally also QNX).</li> <li><strong>IPC / middleware:</strong> a strong grasp of middleware for high-throughput real-time or robotics systems and the trade-offs across vendors and platforms.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional leadership:</strong> the ability to set direction and deliver through influence across many stakeholder teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience in automotive, robotics, or another safety-relevant real-time domain.</li> <li>Familiarity with profiling toolchains (pprof/gperftools, perf, Nsight, NVLumo) and observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog).</li> <li>Experience with NVIDIA (Orin/Thor) and/or Qualcomm compute platforms.</li> <li>Experience with a micro-kernel and/or real-time OS (e.g. QNX) is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2>Why this team</h2> <p>The Runtime Platform team supports Wayve's on-vehicle stack — other on-board components rely on the frameworks, performance, observability, and layers it owns. You'll lead a team whose work contributes to how Wayve scales its AI Driver to new vehicles, OEM programs, and other embodiments.</p> <p>This is a full-time role based in our office in London.&nbsp; At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home. We operate core working hours so you can determine the schedule that works best for you and your team.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">Wayve is committed to creating an inclusive interview experience. If you require any accommodations or adjustments to participate fully in our interview process, please let us know.<br></span></p> <p>We understand that everyone has a unique set of skills and experiences and that not everyone will meet all of the requirements listed above. If you’re passionate about self-driving cars and think you have what it takes to make a positive impact on the world, we encourage you to apply.<br><br>At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition&nbsp; (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. &nbsp;</p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://wayve.ai/careers/">Careers at Wayve.&nbsp;</a></p> <p>To learn more about what drives us, visit <a href="https://wayve.ai/careers/">Values at Wayve&nbsp;</a></p> <p>For US candidates only, please visit <a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1N46n3iN0AG8EPEO-hCanyyv7hzz8KgT_/view?usp=sharing">E-Verify Notice</a> and <a href="https://www.ussc.gov/sites/default/files/pdf/employment/RightToWork.pdf">Participation and Right to Work</a></p> <hr> <p>DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. raw.title: Founding Growth Lead
raw.description:
About the job

At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.

 

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. Your role here isn't just to hit a number, it's to help redefine how an entire market discovers what's possible, and to build the commercial engine that gets us there.

Founded in 2024, we've already gained the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others.

Our early traction enabled us to raise £2.6m in funding and we're now looking to scale faster. We're moving from founder-led sales to a repeatable growth engine and we want someone who has built that engine before, not someone building it for the first time.

 

The Basics

📍 Location: London (4 days a week in our Farringdon office)

⏱️ Experience: 4+ years in outbound-heavy sales/GTM, including time spent building process, tooling, or a team from scratch

🧑‍💼 Reports to: Founders

💰 Pay: Competitive base with uncapped, meaningful upside plus equity

🥇 The role: Lead our commercial engine, own pipeline generation, close new business, and build the playbooks, tooling, and team structure that let us scale beyond founder-led sales

 

The Role

This is the role that builds and runs Adclear's UK commercial engine. We spent two years building a genuine community, a content engine, events and a strong network a lot of what you touch is already warm. But we need someone who's done more than work a warm desk: someone who has stood up a GTM motion before, knows what "repeatable" actually looks like, and can operate directly with founders without a playbook handed to them.

You'll close net-new business yourself, own the full cycle from outbound through to signed retainer, and build the systems - CRM, sequencing, reporting that let the function scale past you. As we grow, you'll be first in line to build and lead the team underneath this role.

You'll sell with the best growth tooling available. We invest in the stack so your time goes where it counts: in front of prospects and building the machine. We use Attio as our CRM, Clay for rev ops, Sales Nav for prospecting, Lemlist for outreach and we're building a fully AI-enabled stack that automates the busywork.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the full GTM cycle end-to-end: ICP definition, outbound, discovery, pilot, close, and retainer conversion

  • Build and own the CRM, sequencing infrastructure, content-to-pipeline flow, and commercial playbook from the ground up

  • Run daily outbound across calls, email and LinkedIn, with phone/in-person meetings as your first move, not your last resort

  • Work our warm engine - content, events, podcast and community leads and convert events into pipeline yourself

  • Check inbound signals daily (website visits, demo sign-ups, content downloads) and act on what matters

  • Partner directly with the founders on pricing, positioning, and GTM strategy

  • Start building the hiring plan and playbook for the team you'll lead as the function scales

  • Report on pipeline health, conversion, and what's working well enough to double down on

 

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

  • You've closed net-new business personally and can point to a repeatable process behind it

  • You've built (or meaningfully upgraded) the CRM, sequencing, and reporting infrastructure the team runs on

  • You're operating with high autonomy and are trusted to make GTM strategy calls with the founders

  • You've made the case for, and started building, the team underneath you

 

Must-Haves

  • 4+ years in outbound-heavy sales or GTM, with a track record of building not just executing, process, tooling, or a team

  • Demonstrated ownership of a full commercial cycle: prospecting through close, ideally including team leadership or cross-functional GTM strategy work

  • Phone-first and comfortable in person you don't hide behind email and LinkedIn

  • Evidence of hitting or exceeding revenue targets in a scaling environment, with numbers to back it up

  • Genuine self-starter who's operated with minimal playbook before and built one from scratch

  • Sharp enough to hold a real conversation about a technical, regulated product without needing to be an expert on day one

  • Comfortable reporting directly to founders and operating with significant autonomy

 

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience selling into regulated industries: fintech, legaltech, or healthtech

  • Experience building or scaling an outbound or broker/referral channel from zero

  • Prior experience as a founding or early commercial hire at a startup

  • Direct experience owning or building CRM/rev-ops infrastructure

  • An established personal presence or content instinct on LinkedIn

 

How We Work

  • Founders are closely involved in the day-to-day

  • No rigid script: you test, learn and adapt on your own initiative

  • You own your pipeline end-to-end, including follow-through after a meeting is booked

  • The pace is fast and the approach is still being built you're one of the people building it

  • This isn't the right role if you want a fixed formula handed to you on day one

 

Benefits

  • Meaningful equity

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Hardware budget

  • Monthly gym contribution

  • Direct path to building and leading the commercial team as we scale

raw.title: Senior Back-end Engineer - Customer Operations Platform
raw.description:
Senior Software Engineer - Customer Operations Platform

Hybrid in London, UK
(1-2 days per week)

We’re looking for a Senior software engineer

iwoca’s operational tools and processes are a competitive advantage, allowing us to give great customer service, manage risk, and get money into our customers’ hands as quickly as possible.

You’ll join our growing Customer Operations Platform team to help improve the systems that power these processes, building tailored flows for our Operations teams, automating processes using AI, using ML models to make smarter decisions, and improving the reliability of our communication services.

You’ll work closely with our Operations teams, getting user feedback and input on requirements from users working in the same building, and seeing the impact of your changes on the people you work with.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The role

As a senior engineer you’d take whole projects end to end, work out what' s actually needed, design it, build it and look after it in production.

Responsibility and Autonomy:

  • Take the lead on complex projects that span many systems and many stakeholders — e.g. CRM, telephony, contact, and task management

  • Build a strong understanding of the business context: how our ops teams actually work, how the processes you're automating are supposed to run, and what the people relying on your systems need from them.

  • Do the detailed technical scoping and prototyping that tells us whether an idea is feasible before it reaches the roadmap.

Delivery and Collaboration

  • Take on complex coding and architecture problems with a high level of ambiguity and technical complexity.

  • Write fluent technical documents and developer tickets distilling product requirements into clear and actionable technical work.

  • Build relationships with key stakeholders including Operations Strategy, Credit Analysts, Account Managers, and Collections teams.

Learning and Growth:

  • Mentor junior developers, fostering a learning environment that encourages experimentation and innovation.

  • Embody our growth mindset mentality by sharing new technologies and best practices within the team as well as more broadly across the company.

The projects

Here are some of the most recent problems we are solving:

  • iwocaChat. Operations staff spend a large share of their day assembling context from multiple systems before they can help a customer. iwocaChat uses Claude to answer those questions directly, so staff spend their time on the customer rather than the lookup.

  • Migrating the monolith. We are incrementally moving business logic out of our Django monolith into smaller, independently deployable services. Because it cuts across every domain, you'd be shaping service boundaries and ownership models that stick around long after the monolith is gone.

  • Inbox messaging reworking. We are replacing our third party email inbox application with an inhouse solution, utilising AI to enable operations staff to automate the actions of our most frequent customer service enquiries.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience developing and owning shared back end services that other engineering teams contribute to and depend on - being the trusted reviewer for their contributions and shaping how they build on top of your work.

  • Familiarity with front-end technologies (React, TypeScript) and browser debugging.

  • Experience building and shaping distributed systems in complex business domains.

  • Ability to translate complex operational needs into technical architecture.

  • Strong capability using AI tools to automate routine tasks and research, enabling greater focus on complex system architecture and critical technical decision-making.

  • You use AI (Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow – whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour and high-stakes decisions.

Bonus:

  • Commercial experience with Python frameworks like Django.

  • Experience with complex data architectures, including event-sourced data models.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 - £110,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a brilliant place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Frankfurt, and Berlin with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and clubs, like bingo, comedy nights, yoga classes, football, etc.

The benefits

  • Flexible working.

  • 25 days’ holiday, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams. This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities. The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers , along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers and work closely with teams across: Customer Support Customer Onboarding Sales and Account Management Product and Product Operations Revenue Operations Finance Data and Analytics Program Management and Operations You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership. You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo remains connected to the customer’s evolving strategic and operational priorities. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager , you will: Own a portfolio of enterprise customers with accountability for customer health, value realisation, adoption, retention, renewal readiness, advocacy, and growth. Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders , positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment. Develop detailed customer success plans that connect the customer’s strategic goals to measurable outcomes, adoption milestones, responsibilities, and timelines. Lead executive business reviews and strategic customer meetings that demonstrate value, address risks, align stakeholders, and create clear next steps. Drive product adoption across complex customer organisations , helping customers expand usage across teams, entities, locations, use cases, and workflows. Create and maintain detailed stakeholder maps , identifying decision-makers, champions, influencers, operational contacts, blockers, and executive sponsors. Identify churn risk early using product usage, engagement, stakeholder, support, financial, organisational, and external business signals. Build and execute churn-prevention plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, customer commitments, and executive escalation paths. Maintain detailed and accurate forecasts across renewals, risk, customer health, expected outcomes, growth opportunities, and major account milestones. Lead renewal-readiness activities by ensuring customer value is documented, risks are addressed, stakeholders are aligned, and commercial partners have accurate account intelligence. Identify and support expansion opportunities by connecting additional Pleo capabilities, products, or use cases to the customer’s evolving business needs. Coordinate complex customer escalations across Support, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams while maintaining clear and confident customer communication. Act as the customer’s internal advocate , ensuring customer needs, feedback, risks, and opportunities are visible to the right stakeholders at Pleo. Navigate customer change effectively , including leadership transitions, reorganisations, acquisitions, market expansion, platform changes, and evolving business priorities. Track customer commitments and outcomes with strong operational discipline, ensuring actions are documented, owned, and completed. Contribute to the evolution of Pleo’s enterprise Customer Success model by sharing best practices, customer insights, playbooks, and recommendations. Support peer development and knowledge sharing across the Customer Success team without holding direct people-management responsibility. To put things into context In this role, you can expect to work on priorities such as: strengthening relationships with Pleo’s largest and most strategic customers improving enterprise customer retention and renewal predictability increasing adoption across complex customer organisations creating stronger executive engagement and governance identifying churn risk before it becomes a renewal issue improving forecast accuracy and account visibility coordinating complex customer needs across multiple internal teams helping customers quantify and communicate the value they receive from Pleo identifying opportunities for expansion and deeper product adoption improving the consistency and quality of enterprise success planning helping customers navigate operational and organisational change turning customer feedback into actionable Product and CX insight You can expect to work across a technology environment that includes CRM, Customer Success platforms, support systems, product analytics, business intelligence tools, workflow tools, and collaboration platforms . Examples may include Vitally, Gainsight or similar, Zendesk, Looker, Tableau or Power BI, Jira, Asana, and Slack. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: At least three years of direct enterprise Customer Success or strategic account-management experience , managing large, complex, and high-value B2B customers. Five or more years of overall experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or a related customer-facing role. Experience working in SaaS, fintech, enterprise technology, or another complex B2B technology environment . A proven record of retaining and growing enterprise customers , including managing renewals, adoption, risk, and value realisation. Strong executive relationship-management skills , with the confidence and credibility to engage senior decision-makers and business leaders. Experience managing complex stakeholder environments involving multiple teams, business units, regions, entities, or decision-makers. Strong churn-prediction and prevention skills , including the ability to interpret customer signals, identify root causes, and build effective recovery plans. Detailed forecasting experience across renewals, customer risk, account health, adoption, and expansion opportunities. Strong commercial judgment , with an understanding of how customer outcomes connect to retention, revenue, expansion, and long-term account value. Excellent verbal and written communication skills , including the ability to lead difficult conversations, present to executives, and simplify complex issues. Experience building strategic success plans, account plans, stakeholder maps, and executive business reviews . Strong analytical skills , with the ability to interpret customer data, product usage, service trends, and business information. Strong cross-functional leadership skills , with the ability to align internal stakeholders without relying on direct authority. A structured and proactive approach to account management , with excellent follow-through and attention to detail. Comfort working in a fast-paced growth environment where customer expectations, internal priorities, and business needs can evolve quickly. The ability to balance strategic relationship management with detailed operational execution . Nice to have Experience in fintech, payments, spend management, financial operations, or expense-management technology Experience working with finance leaders, procurement teams, controllers, CFO organisations, or transformation leaders Experience managing multi-country or multinational enterprise customers Familiarity with ERP, accounting, procurement, or financial-system integrations Experience supporting customers through significant organisational or technology transformation Exposure to AI-enabled Customer Success, predictive health models, automated risk detection, or digital engagement Experience partnering with Product teams on strategic customer feedback and roadmap discussions Experience managing accounts with complex security, compliance, governance, or implementation requirements Why is this role a good fit for you? This role is a good fit for you if: You enjoy building strategic relationships with complex enterprise customers. You are comfortable engaging senior leaders and navigating high-stakes customer situations. You know how to connect product adoption to measurable customer outcomes. You are proactive about identifying and addressing churn risk. You combine strong relationship skills with rigorous account-management discipline. You are confident leading executive reviews, renewal discussions, and difficult customer conversations. You enjoy coordinating internal teams around complex customer needs. You want direct responsibility for protecting and growing some of Pleo’s most important customer relationships. This role is not a good fit for you if: You have not directly managed enterprise or strategic customer relationships. You prefer transactional or high-volume customer portfolios. You are uncomfortable owning customer risk, retention, and renewal readiness. You prefer reacting to customer requests rather than building proactive engagement strategies. You are uncomfortable engaging executive stakeholders or leading difficult conversations. You do not enjoy detailed forecasting, CRM management, and account planning. You prefer working independently without significant cross-functional coordination. You are looking for a people-management role rather than a senior individual-contributor position. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 1 month at Pleo, you’ll: Learn Pleo’s product, enterprise customer journey, value proposition, and Customer Success operating model. Build a detailed understanding of your customer portfolio, including revenue, renewal dates, usage, stakeholders, open issues, risks, and growth potential. Establish relationships with key customer stakeholders and internal account partners. Review and improve success plans, stakeholder maps, account plans, and risk assessments. Establish clear operating rhythms for customer engagement, internal coordination, and forecasting. Identify immediate risks, adoption gaps, and opportunities across your portfolio. In your first 3 months, you’ll: Lead consistent executive and operational engagement across your customer portfolio. Improve customer success planning, value documentation, and renewal readiness. Strengthen the accuracy and detail of customer health and renewal forecasts. Deliver measurable progress against adoption, engagement, and customer outcome goals. Build and execute mitigation plans for at-risk customers. Identify and support qualified expansion opportunities. Become a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders and a reliable source of account intelligence internally. In your first 5 months, you’ll: Build a healthy and well-managed portfolio of enterprise customers. Deliver strong retention and renewal performance. Improve adoption and value realisation across complex customer organisations. Develop trusted relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders. Demonstrate strong forecast accuracy and proactive risk management. Contribute repeatable best practices and insight to Pleo’s broader enterprise Customer Success model. Be recognised as a senior individual contributor capable of managing Pleo’s most important and complex customer relationships. Success in this role looks like Enterprise customers have clear success plans connected to measurable business outcomes. Executive and operational customer relationships are strong and multi-threaded. Customer risks are identified early and addressed through structured mitigation plans. Renewal forecasts are detailed, accurate, and supported by clear account evidence. Customers demonstrate stronger product adoption and value realisation. Escalations are managed with urgency, clarity, and strong customer communication. Internal teams are aligned around customer priorities, responsibilities, and next steps. Renewal and retention performance is strong across the assigned portfolio. Expansion opportunities are identified through customer value and business need rather than transactional selling. Pleo is viewed as a strategic partner rather than simply a product provider. Candidate profile summary The strongest candidate for this role is an experienced enterprise Customer Success professional who combines senior-level relationship skills with commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and disciplined account execution. They have at least three years of direct enterprise experience and are comfortable managing complex customers with multiple stakeholders, high expectations, and significant revenue impact. They know how to earn executive trust, demonstrate value, predict and prevent churn, maintain accurate forecasts, and mobilise cross-functional teams around customer outcomes. They are proactive, credible, highly organised, and capable of protecting and growing Pleo’s most strategic customer relationships. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Application Security Manager to join our Cybersecurity team at Pleo. In this role, you'll own vulnerability management and set the long-term application security strategy, turning a growing stream of signal into a risk-ranked plan the engineering organisation can actually act on. If you're a player-coach who wants high leverage with low bureaucracy, and you'd rather mature a program than maintain one, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our VP of Fraud & Security and lead a small AppSec team with dotted lines to other security members. Your primary customers are Pleo's engineering squads, and your closest partners are DevSecOps, who feed you signal and automation, alongside SecOps, Risk & Compliance, Privacy, and Legal. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to keeping Pleo and its customers safe. You'll also have the chance to shape how the wider organisation thinks about security, well beyond your own team.

What you'll be doing

As a Senior Application Security Manager, you will:

  • Own vulnerability management end to end, covering reporting, triage, mitigation, and the long-term strategy for application security as a department.

  • Build a structured, risk-ranked approach to remediation, so the organisation knows what to fix first and why.

  • Establish clear, company-wide reporting on our vulnerability posture, giving leadership the data-driven visibility they need.

  • Set and deliver an AppSec roadmap, bringing delivery expectations and accountability to a team that hasn't had them.

  • Partner with engineering squads as customers rather than gatekeeping them, embedding proactive security processes into how they already work.

  • Multiply your team's impact through automation and AI, so coverage scales faster than headcount.

  • Grow and mentor engineers, coaching them toward staff-level capability and building their confidence along the way.

  • Support Pleo's compliance obligations across ISO27001, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and the regulatory expectations of each market we operate in, from a security vulnerability perspective.

  • Reduce our attack surface through technical controls, policy, and AI enablement, addressing both external threats and internal risk.

  • Contribute to the broader Cybersecurity team, staying connected with ongoing initiatives and helping shape our 2027 KPIs.

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience steering application security and wider information security strategy in a compliance-heavy environment.

  • A background as a senior security engineer who moved into management, with enough technical depth that you're still credible and still hands-on.

  • A track record of mentoring and growing engineers, and of keeping a team accountable without micromanaging it.

  • Demonstrated experience turning signal into prioritised action through risk-based triage.

  • Experience using AI and automation to scale security coverage, rather than solving everything through headcount or process.

  • The ability to shape culture outside your own team, influencing engineering squads without formal authority over them.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving, complex, ever-evolving environment, where you're self-directed and proactive.

  • Exposure to fintech compliance requirements is a strong advantage. Backgrounds we also look at include DevSecOps and platform security leads with real AppSec depth.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want a fast, visible impact on a program with real room to improve, without having to fight for basic tooling and process first.

  • You treat developers as customers and get satisfaction from security becoming an enabler rather than a blocker.

  • You like being a player-coach, staying close to the technical work while growing the people around you.

  • You're motivated by high leverage and low bureaucracy, and you'd rather build the system than personally do every task.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You're looking to step away from technical work entirely at this level.

  • You prefer to lead through mandate and process rather than partnership and example.

  • You're sceptical of automation, AI, or of leaning on signal from partner teams.

How you'll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Get hands-on with Pleo's application security landscape, understanding our attack surface across payment systems and multi-region infrastructure, and forming your own view of where the real risk sits.

  • Stand up clear vulnerability reporting and a risk-ranked remediation approach, and get key vulnerabilities patched proactively ahead of our next compliance audit.

  • Build trust with engineering squads and start shifting the security culture, so teams come to you early rather than late.

  • Integrate into the Cybersecurity team, connecting with DevSecOps, SecOps, and Risk & Compliance, and begin shaping the roadmap and KPIs that carry the program into 2027.

By 12 months, the goal is a documented, repeatable security program with proactive threat monitoring in place, regulatory readiness for new markets, and a team that can scale.

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into broader leadership, or acquiring new skills.

The location

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25-28 days of holiday (depending on your location) + public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role, your background, and how you feel about the player-coach shape of the job.

  2. Hiring Manager interview: a 60-minute conversation with our security management team, covering your AppSec depth, your evidence of maturing an existing program, and your partnership mindset.

  3. Technical interview: a 60-minute deep dive with our AppSec team on your hands-on application security expertise.

  4. Cross-functional interview: a 30-45 minute conversation with Privacy, Legal, and Risk & Compliance on how you work across those boundaries.

  5. Leadership interview: a 45-minute conversation on mentoring and growing engineers, and influencing without authority.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

  • Multiply your team's impact through automation and AI, so coverage scales faster than headcount.

  • Grow and mentor engineers, coaching them toward staff-level capability and building their confidence along the way.

  • Support Pleo's compliance obligations across ISO27001, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and the regulatory expectations of each market we operate in, from a security vulnerability perspective.

What you bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Demonstrated experience turning signal into prioritised action through risk-based triage.

  • Experience using AI and automation to scale security coverage, rather than solving everything through headcount or process.

  • The ability to shape culture outside your own team, influencing engineering squads without formal authority over them.

  • Exposure to fintech compliance requirements is a strong advantage. Backgrounds we also look at include DevSecOps and platform security leads with real AppSec depth.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

We're looking for someone with proven experience shipping customer-facing AI products who can also confidently operate at Senior level in a SaaS organisation. raw.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
raw.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape how Pleo builds AI-powered product features, working alongside software engineers, data engineers and data scientists to take ideas from prototype to production. Pleo has over 40,000 customers and a decade of unique spend data — an incredible foundation to build on. Your mission will be to harness this data to create real product value.

Please note: applications will be open until 1st September 2026 at 09.00 CEST. We will not review any application before the window is closed so please take all the time you need to submit a great application!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You'll be reporting to the Senior Manager for Data & AI Products and will be one of the first hires in the team but, rest assured, you will not be working solo! You will work very closely with other Engineers and Data Scientists, each bringing distinctive skills while you bring applied AI engineering and data context. Together, the team covers the full chain from data to shipped product.

Your core focus is on building and shipping AI-powered features, with a strong collaborative element across Product Engineering, AI Platform, and Data & ML Platform teams.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer you will:

  • Build and ship AI-powered product features for Pleo’s customers, owning outcomes end-to-end for a scoped area.

  • Design and build end-to-end RAG systems for specific product use cases: chunking strategies, embedding model selection, retrieval optimisation, and quality evaluation.

  • Own the full AI-product lifecycle: prompt design, context and state management, agentic loops, output parsing, edge case handling, and safe production deployment.

  • Build evaluation datasets and automated eval pipelines that give the team confidence in AI feature quality before and after changes.

  • Instrument AI features for production observability: logging, drift detection, quality monitoring, and alerting.

  • Collaborate with Product and Design to scope AI features from first principles; you are a co-author of what gets built, not just an implementer of specs.

  • Partner with our GenAI Platform team to identify infrastructure needs and champion adoption of platform tooling.

  • Support other engineers through reviews, pairing, and pragmatic technical leadership on the projects you lead.

What you bring

You will thrive in this role if you have:

  • Proven experience shipping customer-facing AI features using LLMs; beyond prototype stage and into real production systems with real users.

  • Deep practical experience with RAG system design and the full retrieval pipeline: embedding models, vector databases, chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking.

  • Experience building and operating evaluation frameworks for LLM-based systems; you have a systematic approach to measuring quality.

  • Strong Python engineering; your code is production-grade, tested, and maintainable.

  • Experience building APIs and data retrieval pipelines that feed context into AI systems.

  • Enough data intuition to reason about data quality, schema, and retrieval architecture without needing a dedicated data engineer beside you at all times.

  • Experience with agentic system patterns: tool use, multi-step orchestration, error handling in LLM workflows.

  • Familiarity with public cloud providers (AWS, GCP)

  • We operate a polyglot platform, with components written in Kotlin and Python. While this role is Python-focused, you will need from time to time to contribute in a Kotlin stack, so being open to that is important.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You have strong product instincts and build with the user in mind. You understand that a model is only as good as the problem it solves.

  • You have moved past prototyping and have a deep understanding of the realities of LLMOps, data retrieval, prompt and context engineering, as well as model evaluation in production.

  • You don't just call APIs, you understand the data feeding the AI system and can reason about data quality, architecture, and retrieval without needing a dedicated data engineer beside you at all times.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You are primarily interested in model research or algorithm development. This role is about shipping working AI features to production.

  • You need fully defined specs and a groomed backlog to operate effectively. We expect you to discover and define the problem alongside Product and Design.

  • You cannot explain AI trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. You will regularly work with Product Managers, Designers, and business leaders who need to understand what is and isn't possible.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Familiarise yourself with our codebase, tooling and roadmap.

  • Partner with our Principal Engineer to define and own our approach to AI feature development.

  • Contribute to shaping the roadmap for tooling and features developed by our GenAI Core team.

  • Collaborate with Product and Data teams to ship a first feature to production

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills!

The location

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work.

We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Technical screening: A 15 to 30 minute call with our Talent Partner to check your knowledge of key technical topics

  3. System design interview: A 75-minute practical session with our engineers focusing on scoping and designing an AI feature

  4. Live coding interview: A 75-minute practical session with our engineers focusing on implementing your solution.

  5. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute conversation to deep dive into your knowledge and experience.

  6. Final interview: A leadership interview focusing on your behavioural, communication and collaboration skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: this is neither a research-driven nor a traditional data or software engineering role. We're looking for someone with proven experience shipping customer-facing AI products who can also confidently operate at Senior level in a SaaS organisation. This means we'll be looking for evidence that you can own fairly complex technical features from design to implementation.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

vision coverage</li> <li>Contributory pension</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Be part of a scrappy, dynamic, multidisciplinary, collaborative crew 🏴‍☠️</strong></li> </ul> <hr> <h3><strong>Important Information:</strong></h3> <p>For security reasons background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.
